Whole-equation fade replacement, generic source-out/target-in crossfade, fading structural fission/fusion, LLM-authored math/DOM/pixels/timing/keyframes, or unrelated domain and UI work.
Compositor-core changes without stopping on the failed generic invariant and receiving separate approval.
goal: Ship one canonical no-fade visual animation for 3(x+2)+2(x-1) to 5x+4 with deterministic expanded, collapsed, automatic, and pinned projections over one immutable evaluation tree.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and its completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if mathematics or semantic lineage cannot be independently verified.
Stop if folding changes the canonical trace, result, dependencies, checkpoints, accessible explanation, or export truth.
Stop if existing compositor relations cannot express the required motifs without compositor-core, lifecycle, scheduler, notation-specific geometry, or operation-specific routing changes.

Stop on unresolved overlap, clipping, font swap, baseline jerk, endpoint jump, unexplained line change, seek/rewind drift, or resource leakage.
Stop at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT after slice s23; this checkpoint is not waived, and slices s24-s26 require fresh visual approval.
Stop if work touches unrelated dirty changes, exceeds the approved preservation boundary, or cannot safely record and commit exact slice evidence.
